| [Signal analysis and standardization](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Analyse a machine's signals and standardize them so a second plant can consume them without asking a question. Reads the machine context - PLC program, tag export, sequence or flow chart, layout, handbook, HMI, or the machine itself - to establish how the machine works, inventories the data points an edge platform exposes, checks them against the canonical vocabulary and against what a capability actually requires, finds the name collisions, raw PLC tags and coverage gaps that stop a use case being built, and takes the result through the data-model decision. Use when a machine is newly connected and its signals need naming, when a use case cannot be built because a signal is missing or ambiguous, when two plants' versions of the same signal will not compare, or before publishing any derived data point. Covers the public data models — OPC UA for Machinery, EUROMAP, PackML — so a standard is adopted rather than re-invented, and produces a defined signal analysis report as its output. |
